# Camp Resource: Chem Mystery Machine

__Chem Mystery Machine__

*"Chemically curious? Luckily, this Chem mystery machine is loaded with many different chems for all to try..."*

__Overview__

## **__Function__**

__Function__

Produces Chems

| **Chem** | **Rarity** | **Drop Rate** |
| Addictol | Uncommon | 2.22% |
| Blood Pack | Common | 12.00% |
| Buffout | Uncommon | 2.22% |
| Daddy-O | Uncommon | 2.22% |
| Day Tripper | Rare | 2.22% |
| Disease Cure | Uncommon | 2.22% |
| Fury | Rare | 2.22% |
| Grape Mentats | Rare | 2.22% |
| Glowing Blood Pack | Common | 12.00% |
| Mentats | Uncommon | 2.22% |
| Orange Mentats | Rare | 2.22% |
| Overdrive | Rare | 2.22% |
| Psychobuff | Rare | 2.22% |
| Psychotats | Rare | 2.22% |
| Psycho | Uncommon | 2.22% |
| RadAway | Uncommon | 2.22% |
| RadAway Diluted | Common | 12.00% |
| Rad-X | Uncommon | 2.22% |

- Cost: 15 caps
- Production Rate: 5 min (300 seconds) cooldown period.
- Power Required: No
- Lockable: No. Refer to cooldown period

__Build Information__

- CAMP Build Limit: 1 per camp
- Workshop Build Limit: 1 per workshop
- Build Menu Category: Resources
- Shelter Use: No
- Flamingo Units (CAMP Budget Cost): 1

__Crafting Requirements__

- 1x Circuitry
- 1x Glass
- 1x Gears
- 3x Steel

__Capacity__

- Storage: Refer to cooldown period
